         **Review-Beispiele:**

### Forest {#review-app-2}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      16 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 01.08.2026 - 05.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _AMQ12_, 05.09.2026, 1/5: "This app feels like you’re transported back to 2015. It’s slow, glitchy and the UI is not friendly at all. Compare it to competitors like Voi and it seems like it is at least a generation behind"
            2. _jokal3112_, 11.08.2026, 1/5: "Absolute worst customer service I've ever experienced. My bike was broken, so I couldn't end the ride — the timer just kept running. I then tried every way possible to reach support: emailed 5 times (no response), called twice (couldn't get through), tried live chat twice (it's frozen), and even the email address listed on the website is no longer a working address. Not a single contact channel actually works. On top of that, I regularly lose minutes from my 1,200-minute subscription to broken bikes, and reported bugs never get reimbursed. I had to buy an extra 500-minute bundle, which is now being drained by the exact same issue. The referral bonus I was promised for friends who signed up also never showed up. An app you can't actually reach anyone through when something goes wrong isn't usable. Can't recommend this right now."
            3. _HL46645_, 03.08.2026, 1/5: "This is an objectively terrible app. It has constant issues that cannot be put into a review. It constantly lets you down and is significantly worse than competitors. This wouldn’t be an issue if it didn’t resort to buying monopolies in areas to force people into paying for its horrible service who have no other choice. It will constantly let you down and make you pay for the privilege. Awful"
<!--/ir-theme-->

### Notion: notes, tasks, AI {#review-app-4}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      11 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. __pulliam__, 31.08.2026, 1/5: "From insanely slow loading to constant crashes… I can’t waste more time listing all the things that do not work with this app. I’m baffled how, in 2026, a tech company with a great product can’t figure out mobile. I need to just fully migrate to google docs and just be done with this mess."
            2. _.oliviaaa_, 15.08.2026, 1/5: "There's a lot of issues on mobile compared to the desktop version. For example, when you select a paragraph and try to delete it instead of holding down the delete button, it doesn't delete. Sometimes even when you hold down the delete button, a letter or two doesn't get deleted. It's generally laggy and without a premium subscription, you can't even upload a single video as the file max is 10mb and most videos are over that. You have to find a site and register to embed the videos instead. Overall greedy platform. Used to be good until it became buggy and you're can't upload a video without the app's premium subscription being shoved down your throat."
            3. _AS-QV_, 13.08.2026, 1/5: "Lot of bugs like emoji selection failures, Formatting text on the phone. Notion used to be the minimalist note taking app with seamless UX. Now, it's like any other tech company. Product is pushing to add more features for the cost of reduced usability to boost internal KPIs. Save Notion or I'm out to Obsidian!"

### Forest: Focus for Productivity {#review-app-5}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      10 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 16.06.2026 - 25.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Nathan Jeffs_, 25.08.2026, 1/5: "Used to be a great app and is now a bloated, buggy mess. Leave things as they were!"
            2. _suzicatherine_, 19.08.2026, 1/5: "Harder to use and regularly freezes since the recent update. The whole point is that I should not have to focus on what I’m doing - not think about the app & deal with it crashing. Counterproductive."
            3. _TDTW!_, 17.08.2026, 1/5: "The 2026 redesign is clearly meant to promote the paid subscription model and not for ergonomics. The post-session is now multiple screens showing among other unhelpful analytics the option to watch ads to boost reward. The new interface is buggy, slow, bloated, and often unresponsive. Useful features (e.g. adjusting focus time) are hidden behind unnecessary menus. The pay-to-unlock trees are background noise, but you can't ignore the constant nagging to watch ads or pay. The old interface was good precisely because it's minimalistic. I hope paid users can have the option to revert to the old interface. For other frustrated users: you can still use the interface if you turn on plant together. Apparently this feature will be removed once the new interface officially launches. I hope the developers have the decency to leave it in."
<!--/ir-theme-->

### Tiimo: Daily To Do List {#review-app-15}
